predecessors.text: British Somaliland, independent on 26 June 1960 ('British Somaliland obtained independence on 26 June 1960')

ledger.x: 1960: Italian Somaliland becomes independent and unites with British Somaliland as the Somali Republic.
1960: British Somaliland joins the union on 1 July.
1969: Siad Barre's Supreme Revolutionary Council takes power and renames the country the Somali Democratic Republic.
1977: Somalia and the Western Somali Liberation Front invade the Ogaden.
1991: the north breaks away after Siad Barre falls.
2012: the Transitional Federal Government gives way to the Federal Republic.
